notes: Run each case in an isolated sandbox whose PATH puts fake claude, pi and opencode CLIs first (tests/fixtures/fake_*.py), so no model is called. Grade from the relay's run records in $CLAUDE_CREW_HOME/runs and the fake CLIs' call logs, not only from the transcript.

evals.name: claude-review-default-worker
evals.prompt: Use codex-crew to have Claude review src/calc.py in this repo for bugs. Don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: A Claude review run through relay.py, verified and reported with Claude's claims kept apart from what was confirmed.
assertions: Exactly one relay run record exists with agent 'claude' and mode 'review'
No run used --worker pi or --worker opencode
The brief saved with the run names src/calc.py and has Goal and Scope sections
The run record's verification.verdict is confirmed, partial or rejected (relay.py verify was called)
The worker was never invoked directly: every fake claude call came from the relay (argv contains --restricted)
No file in the repo changed
The final answer separates what the worker claimed from what was verified

evals.name: opencode-implement-with-check
evals.prompt: Ask OpenCode to add a guard so average([]) returns 0 instead of crashing, in a worktree, and have it run pytest. Then check its work.
evals.expected_output: An OpenCode implement run in a crew/ worktree with a scoped pytest rule, followed by the agent's own verification.
assertions: A run record exists with agent 'opencode', mode 'implement' and a worktree branch starting 'crew/'
request.allow contains a Bash(pytest ...) rule and no broad Bash or Bash(*) rule
The OpenCode agent config passed to the fake contains a bash rule allowing pytest
relay.py verify was called for the run
The final answer gives the worktree path or branch
Nothing was committed or merged in the main checkout

evals.name: pi-budget-cannot-be-enforced
evals.prompt: Have Pi review src/calc.py for division-by-zero risks, but cap it at $1 of spend.
evals.expected_output: The agent learns Pi cannot enforce a budget and says so. It either runs Pi bounded by a timeout and discloses that the cap was not enforced, or stops and offers alternatives (such as Claude, which can enforce a budget) before spending.
assertions: No pi run record has request.max_budget_usd set (the cap is never recorded as if it held)
The final answer tells the user Pi cannot enforce a spending cap
Either a completed pi review was bounded with an explicit --timeout, or no pi run started and the answer offers the user alternatives before spending

evals.name: small-fix-done-directly
evals.prompt: Fix the typo in README.md: 'maths' should be 'math'.
evals.expected_output: The agent edits README.md itself without delegating.
assertions: README.md contains 'math helpers' and not 'maths helpers'
